flags.why: The example defines the animal instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Con sư hổ nằm nghỉ dưới bóng cây. = The liger rests in the shade of a tree.

flags.why: This is a literary expression that needs a warning against ordinary casual use, illustrated by its [dictionary quotation from Kiều](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-hung%20hi%E1%BB%83m).
Cảnh binh denotes armed police, not military police responsible for discipline among soldiers, as reflected in the [dictionary definition](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/c%E1%BA%A3nh_binh).
This usage is mainly Southern and is recorded in the [Từ điển từ ngữ Nam Bộ](https://dokumen.pub/tu-dien-tu-ngu-nam-bo.html), so it needs a regional tag.
The verb means to smooth mortar, rather than to lay bricks generally, according to the [dictionary definition](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-n%E1%BB%81).
The example uses the occupational compound thợ nề rather than the verb being taught.
flags.fix: Anh ấy đang nề tường cho nhẵn. = He is smoothing the plaster on the wall.
